extraction.title: Advanced date override handling and timezone compatibility improvements
extraction.head: date-algorithm-enhanced

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as enhancing timezone handling for date overrides across type definitions (an optional timeZone on TimeRange in packages/types/schedule.d.ts), offset-based override adjustments in packages/lib/slots.ts, new parameters (dateOverrides, workingHours, organizerTimeZone) and working-hours fallback in checkIfIsAvailable in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts, and a new test. Confidence score: 1/5. Concludes the PR has critical bugs, including incomplete timezone logic, UTC offset math errors, and a working-hours validation bug.

Bug: "end" should use "slotEndTime" instead of "slotStartTime". Working-hours validation therefore uses the same start time for both bounds. Suggests changing the end calculation to use slotEndTime's hour and minute.
Potential issue: "===" for dayjs comparison may not work as expected. Suggests using the .isSame() method on the two adjusted dayjs values instead.
